text: Calling about a foster placement, girl, 16 months. Temp is 38.4. About twenty minutes ago she had what I can only describe as a fit. She went stiff, then her arms and legs were shaking and her eyes rolled back. It's never happened before, not with us and not in her records. It has stopped now. She's had a mild cough the last day or so, nothing else of note. Please advise what I should do next.
